nodes.speaker: Elder Mira
nodes.text: Oakvale still stands, but the woods do not sleep. Wolves at the palisade, goblin fires in Darkwood, and last night a light in Blackthorn's tower.

nodes.speaker: Elder Mira
nodes.text: Thin the wolves. Bring me proof the road is ours again, and I will put a report in your hands for Brann.

nodes.speaker: Elder Mira
nodes.text: Blackthorn was sealed after the last war. If it wakes, something old is pulling the dead north.

nodes.speaker: Brann Ironkettle
nodes.text: Steel's honest. Men aren't. If Mira sent a report, I'll take it. If you need a blade, I'll sell you one.

nodes.speaker: Brann Ironkettle
nodes.text: Aye. That's her seal. I'll hammer extra rivets into the gate.

nodes.speaker: Lila Reed
nodes.text: Potions, charms, and news — the last one's free: don't drink anything a goblin bottled.

nodes.speaker: Sister Anwen
nodes.text: Light still finds Oakvale. Sit. I can close wounds the woods opened.

nodes.speaker: Sister Anwen
nodes.text: There. Stay out of unmarked graves.

nodes.speaker: Tomas Vale
nodes.text: The Stag has stew, a bed, and rumors. Rumors are cheaper.

nodes.speaker: Tomas Vale
nodes.text: Sleep while the palisade still holds.

nodes.speaker: Tomas Vale
nodes.text: Sela the trapper saw a man in black near the old stones. She said his shadow walked the wrong way.

nodes.speaker: Captain Durn
nodes.text: North gate's the only honest road. Bandits have been cutting purses in Darkwood. If you've steel to spare, I have coin.

nodes.speaker: Captain Durn
nodes.text: Four will do. Don't bring me speeches. Bring me quiet roads.

nodes.speaker: Sela
nodes.text: The trees are sick. Bring me blighted hearts and I'll tell you which way the rot crawls.

nodes.speaker: Ewan
nodes.text: They were going to sell me to something in the castle. Get me back to Oakvale. Please.

nodes.speaker: Inscribed Shade
nodes.text: The Heart was a lock. Malrik made it a key. The graveyard remembers his name.
